title_zh: 用排队类比重新说明任务处理

scenario.label_zh: 练习用类比说明排队机制
scenario.goal_zh: 把含糊的技术说明改为排队类比，并确认听者理解其局限

context_zh: 学生练习面向非技术听众介绍电脑的任务队列。
author: author-phase10-a

sentences.speaker: Theo
sentences.text: I know what the program does, but I can't articulate it without using technical terms.

sentences.speaker: Mei
sentences.text: Try an analogy. Could you compare the waiting tasks to people in a queue?

sentences.speaker: Theo
sentences.text: All right. Each task takes a number and waits until a worker is free to handle it.

sentences.speaker: Mei
sentences.text: That helps with clarity. Does a big task always take the same time as a small one?

sentences.speaker: Theo
sentences.text: No. The queue explains the order, not how long each task takes.

sentences.speaker: Mei
sentences.text: Now I understand. Keep the queue example and that final warning in your presentation.
